# Inspenox Business Suite — Omnichannel Marketing Platform

> Inspenox Business Suite is an enterprise Omnichannel Marketing platform powered by official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (v20.0), Email Marketing (AWS SES), and DLT Bulk SMS messaging.

## Platform Capabilities
- **Meta WhatsApp Cloud API**: Official Meta Graph API v20.0 broadcast engine with dynamic template variables (`{{customer_name}}`), quick reply buttons, action links, sample media sync, and 99.8% open rates.
- **Shared Customer Inbox & Live Support**: 2-way real-time customer messaging, automated bot auto-replies, Excel customer contact import, consent certification, and agent assignments.
- **Automated Multi-Touch Drip Campaigns**: Orchestrate cross-channel marketing workflows across WhatsApp, Email, and SMS with real-time delivery logs, read metrics, and customer segment filtering.
- **Transparent Pay-As-You-Go Billing**: Itemized billing breakdown displaying base usage (Excl. GST) and 18% GST tax invoices with instant UPI, Card, and Netbanking payments.

## Rates & Pricing (Pay-As-You-Go)
- **WhatsApp Marketing Message**: ₹0.8631 / delivered message
- **WhatsApp Utility Message**: ₹0.1150 / delivered message
- **Email Marketing Broadcast**: ₹0.0500 / email sent
- **SMS Marketing (DLT Compliant)**: ₹0.2500 / SMS sent
